why: process.env read outside the config module is a setting the Zod env schema never sees: a typo is discovered at runtime, not at startup. new Anthropic() with no key does the same silently.
bad:
const key = process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY;
const client = new Anthropic();
good:
import { env } from '../env.js';
const client = new Anthropic({ apiKey: env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY });
